top_critical.title: Zbtlink Routers Ship With Root Shell Backdoor
top_critical.summary: At least 20 router models from Chinese manufacturer Zbtlink have been found to ship with a pre-installed backdoor that grants unauthenticated root-level access. The backdoor is present across all 21 f
top_critical.architects_take: Audit your network inventory immediately for any Zbtlink router models and treat them as fully compromised; isolate or replace affected devices and do not attempt to remediate via firmware update alone, as the implant is factory-shipped. If these devices are used in any network segment with cloud connectivity, review access logs for unexpected outbound traffic and rotate any credentials that may have been exposed.
